description: This file defines a helper utility class 'Log' which provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages the chaining of LogNode objects for log message forwarding. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native 'android.util.Log' and facilitates custom logging via LogNode chains.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static logging methods and management of LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode as the head of the logging chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message with VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message with DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message with INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message with WARN priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message with ASSERT priority.
